answer: Root each identity like a willow: two independent proofs must agree before it can trade. A newcomer shows a settled payment receipt of at least $2 and a verified compute job of 15 minutes, both less than 48 hours old, like a garden watered daily. Faking one proof is cheap, but forging both across 1,000 puppets costs $2,000 plus 250 GPU-hours every 14 days. On the mesa, only rooted traders keep a stall.
